text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, Special Week comes up to me with a confident smile on her face.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Would you like to have some summer fun with me?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah! You know, when I was a little, I never got to play at the beach. It was always too cold for that up in Hokkaido.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That's why I have to make the most of this summer! How am I supposed get in a summer mood without any summer fun? So, what do you say, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Did you get this idea from some commercial?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, hehe… Well actually, there's this special feature I read in a magazine, Max Your Summer Fun at the Beach! I thought it sounded kind of nice.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So leave all the preparations to me! We're going to have the best summer ever, just like in the magazine! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day, Special Week and I take a stroll along the shore.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Th-this is so much fun! We're only walking, but my heart's already pounding!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: My heart…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hm…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But the magazine said, "Just by walking side by side with someone, you'll feel like breaking into a dance! ☆"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hm… Let's try the next activity! "Enjoy the wonderful scenery together!" This one should be fine!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Seagull, another seagull… a yacht…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hm… You know, this isn't as much fun as the magazine made it out to be…
choice_data_list: Maybe the magazine's suggestions aren't in line with your tastes.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: My tastes?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, I get it! You're probably right!
choice_data_list: Why not do something you find fun?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Something I find fun?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Well, in that case…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grumble…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Let's get something to eat!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Haaah, eating yakisoba while looking out at the sea is the best!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: This is it! This is the kind of thing I actually enjoy doing!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: The kind of thing that makes me think, "Yaaay! Summer's so fun!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I get it now! This is what it means to make the most of summer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Are you having fun too, Trainer?
choice_data_list: If you're having fun, I'm having fun.
If you're having fun, I'm having fun.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh really now? Hehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Then you pick what to do next! I wanna try something you think I'd enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So what'll it be?
choice_data_list: What about searching for pretty shells?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Pretty shells…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, you must be talking about foraging for seafood! Like clams and mussels!
choice_data_list: No, not the ones you eat…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Are we allowed to keep the shells though? Lemme go ask someone real quick!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My idea was to go look for decorative shells, but it seems there's been a bit of a misunderstanding.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I got an answer! It's okay as long as we don't swim too far out!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All righty! Let's get digging!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Heave ho! Heave ho! Oh look, I found a crab!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We continue to hunt for edible shellfish, enjoying our summer with a certain childlike delight.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: A sandcastle—it's like the sand version of an ice sculpture! That certainly sounds like fun!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But if we're gonna build anything out of sand, I'd rather make a carrot than a castle!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Then I can send a picture of it to my mom!
choice_data_list: I'll take the picture for you.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Cool! All righty, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week gets really pumped about her project, but…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: What a mess… No matter how hard I try, I can't get the tip of the carrot to stop crumbling apart.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Maybe I should've stuck with a castle…
choice_data_list: Don't you need a stable foundation first?
Don't you need a stable foundation first?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: A stable foundation…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh! What about a carrot hamburger steak? Maybe it won't fall apart if I put the carrot on a hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer! Okay, one more time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, Special Week carves out an excellent carrot hamburger steak sand sculpture.
